fields.body_md:
## At a glance

McGill University is in Montreal, Quebec. This page uses its **Master of Management in Analytics (MMA)** to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the fee. McGill lists tuition for the Summer 2027 in-person class at **CAD 79,020** (**₹51.58 lakh**) for international students.

| | MMA (in person) |
|---|---|
| Campus | Montreal |
| Length | 12 or 16 months full time |
| Start | July 2027 |
| Tuition (Summer 2027 class) | **CAD 79,020** |
| Minimum CGPA | **3.0** out of 4.0 |
| GMAT or GRE | Optional |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** or greater |
| Final deadline for international students | **15 January 2027** |

McGill is a designated learning institution. IRCC's list shows it as a public institution. Its DLI number is O19359011033. McGill is in Quebec, so you also need a CAQ.

## What it really costs

The study permit asks you to show enough money for tuition, living costs and travel. Read the [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-proof-of-funds-guide) for the rules.

Tuition for the MMA is **CAD 79,020** (**₹51.58 lakh**). For Quebec, the living amount for one student is **CAD 24,617** (**₹16.07 lakh**) per year, plus your flights. Montreal rents are in our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-cost-of-living).

Rupee amounts use **₹65.27 per Canadian dollar**, the Bank of Canada rate for 27 November 2026. Rates move every day and your bank will charge its own rate, so treat the rupee figures as a guide.

## Getting in

McGill asks for a graduate CGPA of at least **3.0 out of 4.0**, two references and a one-page CV. It does not need the GMAT or GRE. See the [programme page](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/mcgill-university/mcgill-master-of-management-in-analytics) for the details.

## Deadlines

For July 2027, the first deadline is **15 November 2026**. The final deadline for international students is **15 January 2027**.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Management in Analytics, in person](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/mcgill-university/mcgill-master-of-management-in-analytics): 12 or 16 months, tuition CAD 79,020.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if** you want analytics inside a business programme and have strong quantitative skills.

**Think carefully if** your budget is tight. Tuition is high, and Quebec asks for a larger living amount.

- [McGill English language proficiency](https://www.mcgill.ca/gradapplicants/how-apply/you-apply-mcgill/proficiency). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Quebec government: financial resources for international students](https://www.quebec.ca/en/education/study-quebec/required-conditions/costs-studies). Checked on 28 November 2026.

faq_json.q: How much does the McGill MMA cost for international students?
faq_json.a: McGill lists CAD 79,020 in tuition for the Summer 2027 in-person class, about ₹51.58 lakh at ₹65.27 per Canadian dollar. It also lists a waiver of CAD 32,490 for Canadians and permanent residents. Other fees apply.

faq_json.q: What is the McGill MMA deadline for July 2027?
faq_json.a: 15 November 2026 is the first deadline. The final deadline for international students is 15 January 2027.

faq_json.q: Is the GMAT needed for McGill MMA?
faq_json.a: No. McGill says the GMAT or GRE is optional. A score may improve your profile.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does McGill need?
faq_json.a: McGill asks for IELTS Academic 6.5 or greater. You may be exempt if you studied in English in a non-English-speaking country. Check McGill's English page.
